patent.title: Method of producing a flash brewed coffee concentrate
patent.family_note: Holdout INT-2 (international R0). Do not map via TODDY cold-brew brand or other S&D extract patents.

knowledge_origin.description: S&D Coffee assignee; inventorship Maiocchi/Harris/Jones; corporate process RD assumed.

technology.problem: Scale Japanese-style flash-chill coffee flavors into a shelf-stable concentrate without long cold-brew cycles.
technology.mechanism: Flash-brew hot coffee extract then mix with frozen concentrated coffee extract to chill <130°F while raising Brix, optionally reheat/chill for packing.

value_carriers.name: S&D coffee concentrate / TODDY® cold-brew line (candidate)
value_carriers.description: Same assignee brand. Public materials describe cold-brew concentrates; do not disclose flash-brew hot-extract + frozen-concentrate claim practice. Claims check FAIL.

gaps.description: No public evidence a named S&D SKU practices claim-1 flash-brew + frozen-concentrate chilling/concentration.
needed_evidence: Process sheet / product page naming US11533930
Claims chart to commercial concentrate batch

notes: Holdout INT-2. T0=2026-10-13. Claims FAIL → R0. Brand/cold-brew narrative ≠ this grant. Formal V0.7; not V0.8.
